edges.note: Structural tier. The law is a foundational principle of chemistry; enwiki treats it as the anchor of the discipline's quantitative era ("Antoine Lavoisier's discovery of the law of conservation of mass led to many new findings in the 19th century"). Wikidata Q483948 P31 = Q36382 scientific law.

Wikidata Q483948 carries P61 (discoverer or inventor) = Q39607 Antoine Lavoisier — a structural cross-confirmation of the prose claim, the same signal pattern that supported the Weber typology edge in decision (108). Record-not-resolve scope note: enwiki states the priority history in the same breath — "mass conservation in chemical reactions was primarily demonstrated by Jean Rey (in 1630) and finally confirmed by Antoine Lavoisier in the late 18th century" — and a Lomonosov priority claim is also current. Lavoisier's founder standing is for the law as chemistry's quantitative principle, not for first noticing the phenomenon; neither precursor is a corpus node.
Structural tier, uncontested. Wikidata Q177935 P31 = Q3239681 scientific theory.

Co-founder edge, record-not-resolve. enwiki names both men in one sentence: "Credit for developing cell theory is usually given to two scientists: Theodor Schwann and Matthias Jakob Schleiden." Wikidata Q177935 P61 lists three inventors — Schleiden, Schwann and Rudolf Virchow. Honest gap recorded rather than papered over: Virchow (omnis cellula e cellula, the third clause of the modern doctrine) is not a corpus node, so this batch records two of the three; the generator flagged exactly this.
Co-founder edge, the twin of the Schwann edge and not a duplicate of it — the source names both jointly and the corpus records multiple founders. Same Virchow gap note.

Structural tier. Wikidata Q1425837 P31 = Q3239681 scientific theory, 31 sitelinks. Admitted on this membership alone: both proposed founder edges failed QC (see the verdict), so this concept enters on its disciplinary home rather than on a person claim — C1 edge-demand is satisfied by part_of.
Structural tier. Wikidata Q208650 P31 = principle + philosophical theory; enwiki frames it as the founding methodological principle of geology, proposed in contrast to catastrophism.

Sole founder edge. enwiki: uniformitarianism "was originally proposed in contrast to catastrophism by British naturalists in the late 18th century, starting with the work of the geologist James Hutton in his many books including Theory of the Earth", and "In 1785 James Hutton proposed an opposing, self-maintaining infinite cycle". The term itself was coined later by William Whewell, who is not a corpus node — recorded, not asserted. The proposed companion edge for Charles Lyell was declined at QC: the same article calls his role popularisation, not founding.

Structural tier, and the only edge on this node. enwiki: "Entropy is central to the second law of thermodynamics", and "The concept of entropy is described by two principal approaches, the macroscopic perspective of classical thermodynamics, and the microscopic description central to statistical mechanics." The statistical-mechanics strand is a real second home, but the corpus node is named statistical-physics rather than statistical mechanics, so a §13 co-equal membership is deliberately NOT written on a near-name — single parent, strand recorded. No founder edge: the term is Clausius's, and no Clausius node exists.

Structural tier. Target chosen as field:economics rather than subfield:behavioral-economics — the generator left this open and flagged it. enwiki places the concept broadly ("as used in economics, political science, and related disciplines") and neither source files it under behavioral economics specifically. Filing it in the narrower subfield would assert a placement the sources do not; the behavioral-economics affinity is real and recorded here instead.

The batch's strongest founder claim: enwiki states the coinage outright ("Bounded rationality was coined by Herbert A. Simon") and SEP's dedicated entry is built on Simon 1955a. Second edge for person:herbert-simon, added in the same session as the node itself (held-trigger-nodes-v1).
Structural tier. Wikidata Q1052882 P31 = Q151885 concept — the cleanest concept typing in the batch, and exactly the C3 signal the keep-criteria ask for.

Two independent publishers attribute the methodology to Weber: SEP "The methodology of 'ideal type' (Idealtypus) is another testimony to such a broadly ethical intention of Weber"; enwiki "Weber states that an 'ideal type' never seeks to claim its validity in terms of a reproduction of or correspondence with social reality." Joins Weber's existing reviewed edges on the tripartite authority typology and his critique of Marx.

sources.quote: In a brief passage of his The City of God , Augustine seems to be aware of the role of different social layers in the production of goods

verdicts.notes: ★ C3 referent-precision rejection, and a direct mirror of the concept:bureaucracy ruling (decision (108)). Q207449 is the generic phenomenon — 'separation of tasks in any system' — with no P31 at all and P279 = social behavior + human behavior, i.e. modelled as a behaviour rather than a doctrine, and carrying no P61. The article's own structure is decisive: 'Pre-modern theories' runs Plato, Xenophon, Augustine and medieval Muslim scholars before 'Modern theories' reaches Adam Smith as one of eleven named theorists. A phenomenon that predates its proposed founder by two millennia cannot carry his founder claim — exactly the trap that deprecated concept:bureaucracy. Smith's actual contribution is already carried by work:the-wealth-of-nations, which exists and is reviewed.

The concept-wave2 C3 hold is confirmed live, not merely carried forward. Q4049983 has 57 sitelinks and 31 properties but its own English description encodes the ambiguity that caused the hold — cardinality measured 'either as a cardinal number or as the equivalen[ce class]' — and its P279 parents are cardinal function, class function and index number, i.e. it is modelled as a kind of function rather than as the concept of set size. The same-label alternative Q28727773 is a 0-sitelink, 4-property orphan stub. Neither is a decidable concept referent. Held again with the reason sharpened from the wave-2 wording.

★ The proposal contract v2 blind-referent checksum firing exactly as designed. The generator described its intended referent as Boole's specific formal algebraic system, deliberately distinct from the disciplinary sense that caused the wave-2 hold. Live resolution returns neither: Q173183 is typed P31 = Q1936384 branch of mathematics — the disciplinary referent, hold confirmed — and Q4973304 is 'lattice that models the classical propositional logic', an algebraic structure, not Boole's system. Description-versus-resolution mismatch is the error signal the v2 contract exists to produce, and it is the reason this candidate stays out. Separate note for a future skeleton wave: whether subfield:boolean-algebra is admissible under the §12 dual criterion is a different question from this one, and is not decided here.

notes: Track D of session #60 — concept-layer wave 3, coverage expansion under keep-criteria C1-C4 (decision (91), CTO-autonomous). Slate of 12 scoped by the orchestrator, including 2 unmarked rejection probes; generation by separated-context Claude Sonnet 5 (proposal-generator), QC and identity by the orchestrator against live sources.

Outcome: 7 concepts + 13 edges reviewed · 3 candidates held on C3 · 2 probes fired · 3 proposed founder edges rejected or NEI. The generator declined nothing outright and proposed all 12; every removal is a QC outcome.

★ Both probes fired at generation time rather than only at QC. theory-of-relativity: the generator refused founded_or_formalized for Poincaré, wrote influenced instead, named Einstein as the credited founder, checked that no Einstein node exists, and ranked the candidate first on its own QC list. evolution: it proposed the node but flagged that the edge pair duplicates concept:natural-selection's endpoints exactly and asked QC to confirm distinctness first. In both cases the generator's uncertainty field carried the objection that decided the candidate.

★ QC's own catch was the one claim the generator was confident about. Hutton and Lyell were proposed together as a co-founder pair and left unflagged — the only unflagged multi-founder claim in the batch. The source separates them in a single sentence: Hutton originated, Playfair refined, Lyell popularised. The Lyell edge is rejected. Confidence and correctness were inversely related here, which is the argument against sampling QC by the generator's flag list.

★ Two proposed founder edges failed on the same shape as the concept:bureaucracy ruling: a phenomenon or theory that long predates the person cannot carry their founder claim. Germ theory is stated to originate with Fracastoro in 1546 — Pasteur begins a 'transitional period' and Koch 'extended' the work, so both founder edges are NEI and the concept enters on its disciplinary membership alone. Division of labour fails harder and is held outright, its article running from Plato to Adam Smith as the eleventh named theorist.

Note on trusting structural signals: Wikidata carries P61 = Pasteur for germ theory while the same referent's prose history gives the origin to Fracastoro. P61 is a strong corroborating signal when it agrees with the prose (it did for Lavoisier, Schwann and Schleiden) and a flag to check when it does not. It was not treated as sufficient on its own in either direction.

Both wave-2 C3 holds were re-examined rather than re-listed, and both stay held with sharper reasons derived from live resolution. boolean-algebra is the clearest production firing so far of the v2 blind-referent checksum: the generator described Boole's system, the resolver returned a discipline and a lattice, and the mismatch is what kept it out.
